titulo.alumno: Expectation and suggestion · Nuances of particles

intro: Part 1: expectation and suggestion. Read the heading and find the detail that answers the question.

texto: Particles don't have a fixed translation. «Nok» can present an expectation; «da» can soften a suggestion or remind of something shared. Context decides the interpretation.
